verdict.rationale: Hightouch's own docs show that syncs run unattended on a schedule or trigger you set, report the outcome of each run, and send alerts when a run fails. Automated journeys and AI Decisioning agents with scheduling rules add autonomous campaign automation, and the MCP server lets an AI assistant create audiences and syncs in plain language. Marketers review agents' work before launch, which is a deliberate human gate rather than a lack of automation. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of schedule/trigger configuration options, independent or hands-on corroboration of unattended background runs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: A sync runs on the schedule or trigger you set, then reports the outcome of each run so you can confirm it worked.
Sync modeled data to sales, support, analytics, and internal tools on a schedule or when data changes.
Sync to 300\+ destinations in real-time or on a recurring schedule.
Get notified when a run fails
build automated journeys, and use the built-in agent to explore segments and analyze campaign performance in natural language.
Each agent combines everything a campaign needs to learn and improve: an audience, goals, messages, scheduling rules, and guardrails.
